subject: Decision Making
subcategory: The Science of Risk and Reward
title: Expected Value Thinking
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Expected Value Thinking.

hook.text: A bet pays $100 with 10% chance and $0 otherwise. Its expected value is $10. This simple math guides rational decisions.

buildup.text: Expected value multiplies each outcome by its probability and sums the results.

discovery.text: Pascal used expected value to argue for believing in God. Infinite heavenly reward times any small probability equals.

twist.text: Expected value fails for rare catastrophes. A one percent chance of bankruptcy has expected value near zero but can.

climax.text: Expected value is a starting point, not the whole answer. Add risk tolerance and ruin probability for a complete.

punchline.text: Multiply odds by outcomes. Expected value works until one bad outcome can ruin.

quiz.question: When does expected value thinking fail?
options: When a rare outcome can cause total ruin regardless of low probability
